    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Action
    Interface for all in-game actions.
    ActionExecutor
    Executes actions in the game context.
    ActionFactory
    Factory for creating Action instances based on ActionType or Pet.
    ActionFlavorService
    Adds lightweight flavor lines to common action outputs.
    ActionRequest
    Marker interface for request payloads passed from UI/application layer into action domain execution.
    ActionType
    Enum of all action types available in the game.
    ActionUIAdapter
    Abstraction layer for UI operations needed by actions.
    AdultSim
    Adult Sim: balanced stat decay and earnings.
    AmountActionRequest
    Request payload carrying a single amount for banking actions.
    ApplyLoan
    Banking action: Apply for a loan up to the system limit.
    Asset
    Abstract base class for all ownable assets: cars, houses, hotels.
    Bank
    Bank location: offers financial operations and work for Bank Tellers.
    BankAccount
    Manages a bank account balance for a Sim.
    BankingSystem
    BankingSystem manages all banking operations including accounts, loans, and interest.
    BankService
    Core banking service managing accounts, loans, and interest.
    BankTellerJob
    Bank Teller job: high intelligence skill, works at bank.
    Bed
    World object: Bed for sleeping.
    Bookshelf
    World object: Bookshelf for reading.
    BoundedStat
    Represents a 0-100 bounded stat with automatic clamping.
    BrushTeeth
    Action: Brush teeth for minor hygiene improvement.
    Bunny
    Bunny pet subclass.
    BusinessUIManager
    Manages location travel, asset operations, and location action menus.
    BuyPet
    Pet action: Buy a pet from the pet store.
    BuyPetActionRequest
    Request payload for pet purchase flow.
    Car
    Car asset: can be owned and used for travel, reducing fatigue cost.
    Cat
    Cat pet subclass.
    ChefJob
    Chef job implementation: high cooking skill, works at restaurant.
    ChildSim
    Child Sim: slower energy drain but faster hunger and bladder.
    Cleaning
    Action: Clean public areas for cleaning skill improvement.
    Computer
    World object: Computer for playing games.
    ConsoleGameLogger
    Console-based implementation of GameLogger.
    ConsoleGameLogger
    Console-based implementation of GameLogger.
    ConsoleUI
    Main console-based UI for the game.

    Deterministic 7-day economy cycle for predictable gameplay and tests.
    DailySummaryService
    Builds and logs end-of-day summaries for each sim.
    DefaultLoanRulePolicy
    Default loan overdue policy: repossession after 60 days and bankruptcy death after 80.

    Banking action: Deposit Simcoin into bank account.
    DoctorJob
    Doctor job implementation: requires intelligence and charisma, works at hospital.
    Dog
    Dog pet subclass.
    EatMeal
    Action: Eat a proper meal, restoring hunger and improving cooking.
    EatSnack
    Action: Eat a light snack with modest hunger restoration.

    Policy contract for selecting the economy state by in-game day.
    EconomyState
    Daily economy state that drives hotel income multipliers.
    Effect
    Immutable-ish effect: a set of deltas applied to needs.
    ElderSim
    Elder Sim: faster energy and hygiene drain but less social needs.
    Exercise
    Action: Exercise for fun and fitness improvement.
    ExitGuard
    Handles graceful shutdown and emergency save on unexpected exit.
    ExperienceUtils
     
    FeedPet
    Pet action: Feed a specific pet.
    FeedPetMenu
    Interactive action that lets the player choose which pet to feed.
    FileSaveRepository
    File-system backed persistence adapter for savegame.txt.
    Fridge
    World object: Fridge for eating meals.
    Game

    GameClock
    Manages game time progression and conversion between real-world and game time.
    GameContext
    Game context adapter providing actions with UI and game state access.
    GameLogger
    Interface for game logging/messaging.
    GetCheckup
    Health action: Sim gets medical checkup at hospital for 10 Simcoin.
    GroomPet
    Pet action: Groom a specific pet.
    GroomPetMenu
    Interactive action that lets the player choose which pet to groom.
    Home
    Home location: requires owned house, offers residential actions and pet care.
    Hospital
    Hospital location: health checkups and Doctor employment.
    Hotel
    Hotel asset: generates 250 Simcoin daily passive income.
    House
    House asset: unlocks Home location with residential actions.
    InfluencerJob
    Influencer job: requires charisma, can work at park or restaurant.

    Handles user input from console.
    InterestPolicy
    Interface for interest calculation policy.

    JobFactory
    Factory for creating Job instances.

    LoanRulePolicy
    Policy contract for applying loan-related consequences.

    Abstract base class for all game locations.
    LocationActionFactory
    Factory for creating location-specific actions.
    LocationActionFactory.LocationActionType
     
    LocationKey
    Typed keys for all travel locations.
    LocationManager
    Manages all game locations and world objects.
    Main
    Entry point for the Sims simulation game.
    MenuUIManager
    Manages main menus including start, Sim management, and sub-menus.
    MidnightEnergyDrainPolicy
    At night (23:00-07:59), all Sims lose extra energy.
    Money
    Immutable Money class representing currency amount.
    Nap
    Action: Take a short nap to restore energy.
    NeedCrisisPolicy
    Handles non-lethal need crises and forced events.
    Needs
    Duplicate Needs class in sims package (see stats.Needs for primary).
    Needs
    Manages all six Sim needs: hunger, energy, hygiene, social, fun, and bladder.
    NeedType
    Enum of all need types in the game.

    Interface for ownable assets.
    Park
    Park location: offers outdoor recreation and work opportunities.
    Pet
    Abstract base class for all pets.
    PetFactory
    Factory for creating Pet instances by type.
    PetStore
    Pet Store location: buy and groom pets.
    PetType
    Enum of available pet types with display names and prices.
    PlayGame
    Action: Play games for fun and gaming skill.
    PlayWithPet
    Pet action: Play with a specific pet.
    PlayWithPetMenu
    Interactive action that lets the player choose which pet to play with.
    ReadBook
    Action: Read books for fun and intelligence improvement.
    RepayLoan
    Banking action: Repay part or all of the outstanding loan.
    Restaurant
    Restaurant location: dining and Chef employment.
    SaveGame
    Handles game serialization and persistence.
    SaveRepository
    Port for game persistence operations.

    Request payload carrying a menu selection index.
    Sellable
    Interface for assets that can be sold.
    Shower

    ShowerPet
    Pet action: Shower a specific pet.
    ShowerPetMenu
    Interactive action that lets the player choose which pet to shower.
    ShowerStall

    Sim

    SimAssetsComponent
    Manages Sim assets: cars, houses, hotels and repossession logic.
    SimAssetsComponent.PurchaseResult
     
    SimBankingComponent
    Manages Sim banking operations: deposits, loans, simcoin, and wealth.

    Manages Sim employment: jobs, job levels, work actions.
    SimEmploymentComponent.WorkResult
    Result of a work action: whether successful, message, stats effect, and earnings.
    SimManager

    SimPetsComponent
    Manages Sim pets: adoption, aging, and death.
    SimpleInterestPolicy
    Simple interest policy: 0.05% daily interest on deposits.
    SimStatsComponent
    Manages all Sim statistics: needs, skills, and death conditions.
    SimType
    Enum of Sim age types with different stat decay rates and earnings.
    SimUIManager

    Skills
    Manages all Sim skills: cooking, cleaning, charisma, fitness, intelligence, creativity, gaming, and work ethic.
    SkillType
    Enum of all skill types with display names.

    SleepWithPetMenu
    Interactive action that lets the player choose which pet to sleep with.

    Action: Socialize to improve social need and charisma.
    Street
    Street location: starting area with no actions, used for navigation.

    TimeRulePolicy
    Policy contract for time-based world rules.
    Toilet
    World object: Toilet for bladder management.
    TravelEffectPolicy
    Policy contract for side effects when a Sim travels between locations.
    Treadmill
    World object: Treadmill for exercising.
    TV
    World object: Television for entertainment.
    UIHelper
    Utility class for UI formatting and color management.
    Usable
    Interface for world objects that can be used (bed, fridge, etc).
    UseToilet
    Action: Use the toilet to restore bladder need.
    WalkTravelFatiguePolicy
    Applies travel fatigue when Sim travels without owning a car.
    WatchTV
    Action: Watch TV for fun and creativity improvement.
    Withdraw
    Banking action: Withdraw Simcoin from bank account.
    Work
    Action: Work at current job to earn Simcoin and advance job level.
